root: ^Is this a message from above?? Have I been too greedy and now I have been punished??
^Hmm. Perhaps the gods are telling me something.
^I have been given so much by them and now something must be taken away.
^You’re taking the loss of your legs surprisingly well.
^Hello?? What about me? Where’s my happy ending?
^Life is so unfair. The sea is a prison of despair.
